description: A Flutter provider class managing the payment flow, including starting checkouts, receiving payment results, and clearing state. It interacts with an external PaymentsService and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: PaymentsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages payment state and workflow within the app, providing methods to start checkouts, handle results, and clear internal data.

methods.name: startCheckout
methods.description: Initiates the checkout process for a specific course and user, setting processing state, creating a checkout session via PaymentsService, and notifying listeners.

methods.name: receivePaymentResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a payment, updating receipt information and processing state based on success or failure, ensuring session match.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the provider’s internal state and notifies listeners.
